programs.cycle_status: Cycle 3 concluded with the finals and awards ceremony on 7 October 2026. POP by Kwelio was named Dubai's App of the Year. No Cycle 4 of the Create Apps Championship has been announced: on the same day DCDE launched the Create AI Agents Championship as its successor (see the create_ai_agents_championship record).
programs.official_page_consistency_note: The finals took place on 7 October 2026, as the page's structured Competition Timeline stated; the stale FAQ answer saying the competition concludes in April 2026 was wrong and was still on the page on 13 October 2026, as was an outdated App Olympics 2024 banner.

programs.name: Create AI Agents Championship
categories: Best Youth AI Agent (lead participant under 21 at registration)
programs.prize_pool_note: Dubai Media Office cites a pool exceeding AED 2.5 million: AED 550,000 for each of four category winners, plus AED 1 million and the AI Agent of the Year title for one of them. The official page states USD 150,000 per category and does not state the extra amount.
programs.eligibility_summary: Open worldwide to individuals and teams (up to 6 members), technical or non-technical, no minimum age; free to enter; ideas, prototypes and early MVPs accepted; submissions in English. Entrants submit an AI-agent prototype, pitch deck and demo video.
programs.registration_close_note: Dubai Media Office and the official FAQ say registration closes in December 2026; the official page timeline says January 2027. Confirm the deadline on the official page before relying on either.

programs.name: Create Apps Accelerator Programme
programs.audience: High-potential teams within the Create Apps Championship ecosystem, including participants who did not reach its final stages.
programs.application_status: Participation follows the Championship programme; no separate open application window was verified.

submission_guide.tip: Create Apps Championship Cycle 3 is complete (finals 7 October 2026) and no Cycle 4 is announced. New entrants should look at the successor Create AI Agents Championship, open for registration since 7 October 2026 at https://www.dubaichamberdigital.com/en/create-ai-agents.
